text: It was finished.
Oh, yes, it's finished, my dear, but...
Oh, come on, Doctor, we haven't got time for buts.
This is our only hope.
Yes, you realize, of course, we're taking a terrible chance.
You can save your breath.
We've got to try it.
Really well, my boy.
Pull the main switch.
The mission has been completed successfully.
With guile and cunning, I have been able to repossess the Terranium.
Are you certain it is the real Corp?
Of course.
I had it examined before we arrived here.
It is ready to be fitted to the Time Destructor.
I hope that the Daleks will not suffer any more setbacks
which could upset the plans for our conquest of the universe.
The final conference of the Quatu.
I shall go and address them presently.
Time Destructor, that is being done.
We now deal with my big chin.
But that you, Spock...
Unfortunately, there's no damage done to the control panel itself.
But the directional unit?
No, that's useless, dear boy, useless.
Take a look for yourself.
What happened?
Well, the unit required a much higher energy rate than we possess.
Then why did it burn out and not the TARDIS controls?
A built-in safety measure, my dear.
You see, the excess energy must have forced itself back into the directional unit.
And that means our plans to return to Campbell have failed.
That means that the Daleks can invade the universe and conquer it.
Yes, and there's nothing we can do about it.
There must be something we can do, Doctor.
You must try to think of some way.
Well, our only chance, my dear, is to try and capture the Monk's time machine or that of the Daleks.
Yes, well, let's get going.
Now, have patience, dear boy.
It's highly probable they've all left by now.
And I should think there's one or two of those Egyptians around.
Let's take a look on the scanner.
But that's not ancient Egypt.
It's more like Campbell.
Yes.
Yes, it's vaguely familiar.
Yes, it might be Campbell.
You know, that means that that directional unit must have burnt itself out after we dematerialized.
I wonder if you'd bring me that impulse compass.
Yes, sure.
Well, now, young lady, perhaps you'll have more faith of me in the future.
I thought something had worked out.
But it was you who said we'd failed.
Oh, nonsense, nonsense, failed, nonsense.
Well, it wasn't me.
Of course it was.
Oh, come on, Doctor, you'll have to forgive her.
After all, she hasn't known you very well.
Yes, well, perhaps, perhaps.
Anyway, now we're here, I think we'd better make a plan.
Well, how far do you think we are from the Dalek city?
I've no idea.
Now, I think we might be able to make it on foot.
Perhaps I'd better go out and take some bearings.
Open the door, dear boy.
Yes.
That man, he was as much in the dark as we were, and now he has the gold.
Very good.
You're getting to know him quite well.
Before this is over, I'll save it for the Daleks.
There has been so much time wasted through the folly of the representative from Earth,
surely it is only right that on his return he be removed from this council.
But without him, there will be no Terranium.
The Daleks have assured us that they will recapture the core of the Time Destructor.
Then we do not need Marvick Chen.
Exactly.
He no longer merits a place on this galactic council.
I call for a fencer motion.
Even as you sit here,
the great war force assembled under the Daleks is awaiting the final order
to set out and conquer the universe.
Why is Marvick Chen speaking for the Dalek Supreme?
The final checks are being made, and in a very short time,
that final order will be given.
Why is it that Marvick Chen is in possession of information denied to the rest of this council?
Well, the Daleks have the right to do so.
We are equal partners with the Daleks in this great conquest.
Some of us are more equal than others.
The representative speaks out of turn.
No.
My contribution of the M of Terranium is greater than all of yours put together.
You have been dwarfed!
This violates the agreement by which this council was assembled.
Harry!
Unrest him! Unrest him!
Before this conference began, the Dalek Supreme and I spoke together.
This council now is under my power.
I will give the orders. You will obey them.
This jungle is hardly the place I'd choose for a gentle stroll.
Just be careful of the Vargas.
Vargas? I haven't seen any Vargaplos.
They're all over the place.
Neither have I.
I thought the Daleks scattered them all over Campbell.
Stephen, you're sure we are on Campbell?
Of course I am. The doctor was certain when he took these re...
Where is he?
We have all served the common cause! All of us!
Indeed we have.
But I, Mavic Chin, was solely responsible for the recovery of the core of the town.
I'm a prime destructor.
Because of this, I naturally precede anyone here.
For without my power, the Daleks cannot succeed.
You do appreciate the point.
There remains one question.
Where is your co-ruler, the Dalek Supreme?
He was...
He knows that I can run this council without his aid.
Now, gentlemen, we come to the main discussion before this meeting.
The apportioning of the government of the universe after the conquest.
All of you will be allowed to oversee your own galaxies.
But all of you will be responsible to the Dalek Supreme and me.
This meeting is over!
But it is not yet begun!
There will be no more discussion!
All representatives will come with us!
Where can he have got to?
Anywhere you like out there.
Perhaps the Daleks have caught him.
Then now they'll be looking for us.
Look, Steven, with or without the Doctor, we've got to get to the Dalek city and find a way of putting that place out of action.
Yes, but Sarah, what about the Doctor?
He can't just have vanished into thin air.
We've got to find him.
No, not yet.
Mavic Chin will have returned with the Terranium.
That means the Dalek's plans will be ready to go ahead.
And we've got to stop them.
I understand that.
But we can't just leave the Doctor wandering around lost in this jungle.
If I know anything about him, he's already reached the city.
If we go there, we can stop the Daleks and find the Doctor.
Strongest signals on bearing 242.
According to the Doctor, the Dalek city is over there.
Where to now?
I'll just take another reading.
What exactly is it?
So far, so good. We're on the right track.
The source of power is still 242.
Would you mind telling me how that thing works?
What, now?
Yes, now.
Look, Sarah, this is no time for a lesson on the power impulse compass.
Supposing something happens to you?
What are you talking about?
I'd have to go ahead and reach the city alone.
Don't you think you ought to show me how it works in case of accidents?
Oh, you're so cheerful, aren't you?
The galactic representatives have been detained as you instructed.
They will be destroyed at the same time as the headquarters at the start of the conquest of the planet Earth.
Commence invasion.
There it is, the take-off area.
Yes.
Are those the Dalek ships?
No, those belong to the other representatives.
Where's the Dalek landing area?
There, too, possibly.
But those representative ships will have to take off first to collect their forces for the invasion.
Right. Let's get going.
Just a minute.
Why?
We've got to defeat the Daleks.
We've got to try to defeat the Daleks.
If you and I just charge in there, what chance do you think we've got against the greatest war force ever assembled?
Oh, for heaven's sake, we'll go carefully.
Look, Stephen, just because the doctor isn't here, don't think that you're the only one who can outwit the Daleks.
Look, I don't think that.
But as you said, in any case, we'll probably find he's here already.
Come on.
I don't get it.
It's uncanny. I mean, where have the Daleks got to?
It's like a city of the dead.
Let's see if there's any sign of life down here.
They haven't come very far yet.
What's that got to do with it?
Well, they're probably making final preparations for the invasion.
Yes, well, they'd still leave guards out.
Maybe they're not frightened.
Well, they always take some precautions.
All right, you think of an explanation.
Well, look, suppose... suppose the doctor did come here.
And they have caught him.
Then now they'll be looking for us.
No, possibly not. Not if he said he was alone.
Oh, they wouldn't believe it.
Why not? We weren't anywhere around.
This could all be a trick.
If they have caught the doctor, then they could be waiting for us.
No.
Now, if they've caught the doctor, they won't worry about us.
We've got to find him.
This place is empty, too.
Then it must be a trap.
Why?
Well, it looks like a control room.
The Daleks wouldn't leave a place like this unguarded.
Yes, that's true.
That means they must have the doctor if they can be this sure of themselves.
Hey, isn't this their time machine?
Now we can get back to Earth and warn them.
Yes, except that neither of us knows how to work it.
But we could bluff them.
How?
Look, if we could lock ourselves inside that time machine
until they let the doctor come to us, well, he could work it.
It's worth a try.
Now we've got to contact the Daleks.
Stephen, here's the Dalek loudspeaker system.
This is Sarah Kingdom of Space Security.
Send the doctor to the control room.
I'd better try and get into that time machine.
Hello?
Kingdom?
They must still be working with us.
Mavic 10, can you hear me?
Let us speak to the doctor.
Is this more treachery?
Who are these people?
They are the people who stole the terranium.
Why have they come back?
I don't know.
You must let me speak to the doctor.
Now!
Already you have betrayed us.
This could be another trick.
Mavic 10!
Don't waste time.
They'll be on their way to us by now.
Yes, but if they don't bring the doctor, the plan's useless.
Listen to me!
Who's that?
Where are you?
Yes, but where?
We've got to find them.
This could all be part of the trick.
No, I don't think so.
Look, if there were any Daleks around, they'd be here by now.
They must have gone.
Maybe the doctor's with the council. Come on.
Mavic 10!
If this is a further trick, we shall destroy you before they can destroy us.
It's not a trick!
Then why have they come back?
If you'd only think!
Is there no sense in the outer galaxies?
It is clear that they have lost their leader, the one they call the doctor.
The girl has brought the young man here to look for him.
But really she has come back out of loyalty to me.
To ensure my safety as the guardian of the soul.
Now, uh...
How should I know?
Just look at this place. It's fantastic.
Come along. No time for sightseeing.
Let's try down here.
The efficiency of our security system is one of the main reasons for our natural supremacy.
What about the Daleks?
Once we're out of here, we can destroy the Daleks.
Between us, we can muster a greater force than they.
We can form our own galactic council.
Listen!
Kingdom, you've done well.
Now let us out of here.
No.
What do you mean, no?
Where is the doctor?
If he is your leader, he is not with us.
Where is he?
I don't know. Now let us out.
So that you can rejoin the Daleks? Not likely.
Absurd! The Daleks have betrayed us.
Betrayed?
Why should we rejoin them?
If we let them out, there's just a chance that some of them could mobilize a force.
A force to defeat the Daleks.
Of course we will.
How can we trust them?
You must. The Daleks must be destroyed.
Our old galaxies are in danger.
We have no choice.
Very well.
But the Daleks have already left, Campbell.
It's probable that their invasion plans are already going ahead.
And the universe can be taken by surprise because of your grief.
Must you moralize, Albert?
Your only chance is to go back to your own people and warn them.
Our people will kill us.
Not if we save them.
We must destroy the Daleks.
Destroy!
We agree to go and defend our galaxies and to organize a search for the Dalek invasion force.
Let them out, Stephen.
Yes, all right.
You are a sensible woman, kingdom.
I will see you are justly rewarded.
There they go.
Yes, let's hope they'll be in time.
Look, there's the ship of Salation and Beos.
Chen's ship is still there.
Yes, he must be nearly the last one to take off.
What about the others?
Those must belong to the dead representatives.
Chen's taking his time to get off.
There he goes.
No!
Something's gone wrong.
Now he won't be able to get back to Earth and warn them.
Let's hope that the others can mobilize fast enough.
There must be something we can do.
Yes, find the doctor.
The doctor?
No!
We must follow it.
Right into the heart of the mountain.
Underground.
Why didn't we think of that before?
Sarah, it's possible the invasion hasn't started yet.
Maybe the rest of the forces are down there.
Part of them.
There must be hundreds of places like that.
Yes, but that Dalek must know that the representatives got away.
He might even know that we're on Kemba.
If the representatives gone and the doctor disappeared,
we're going to have to put them out of action ourselves.
Can we?
We've got to.
Earth will still be invaded.
Certainly.
Thanks to you.
You can, but you're dead.
Not yet, my innocent ones.
Though I'm delighted my pyrotechnical display impressed you.
No, I am alive and soon shall be master of the universe.
Perhaps, kingdom, you'd like to lead the way.
Down there?
Of course.
I'm certain the Daleks will be delighted to see you.
